campaign: Executable tightening: inference contracts and observation ownership
doctrine: Deletion-led waves. Existing tensor, model, recipe, cache, and evidence owners remain authoritative. Move every caller and delete displaced checks, wrappers, copies, and loops in the same commit. No compatibility paths. Preserve numerical behavior. Require net-negative production surface, focused host tests, changed-path CUDA tests, and exact plan gates.
